import re, collections
product_id=2643
# 1) Fetch questions that match battery
questions=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    res=apis.amazon.show_product_questions(product_id=product_id, query='battery', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    page_items=res if isinstance(res,list) else (res.get('questions') or res.get('results') or [])
    print('questions page',page_index,'count',len(page_items))
    if not page_items:
        break
    questions.extend(page_items)
    page_index+=1
print('total battery-related questions',len(questions))
for q in questions:
    print('Q',q.get('question_id'), 'answers', q.get('num_answers'), 'text', q.get('question'))

# 2) For each such question, fetch verified answers
verified_hour_values=[]
verified_answers=[]
for q in questions:
    qid=q.get('question_id')
    page_index=0
    answers=[]
    while True:
        res=apis.amazon.show_product_question_answers(question_id=qid, is_verified=True, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        page_items=res if isinstance(res,list) else (res.get('answers') or res.get('results') or [])
        if not page_items:
            break
        answers.extend(page_items)
        page_index+=1
    print('verified answers for question',qid,'count',len(answers))
    for a in answers:
        txt=a.get('answer') or ''
        # extract hour-like tokens: 10 hours, 15 hr, 15hrs
        for m in re.finditer(r'\b(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(hours?|hrs?)\b', txt, flags=re.IGNORECASE):
            verified_hour_values.append(float(m.group(1)))
            verified_answers.append((qid, a.get('question_answer_id'), a.get('created_at'), m.group(0), txt))

print('verified hour values from Q/A',verified_hour_values)

# 3) Fetch verified reviews that mention battery
review_hour_values=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    res=apis.amazon.show_product_reviews(product_id=product_id, query='battery', is_verified=True, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    page_items=res if isinstance(res,list) else (res.get('reviews') or res.get('results') or [])
    print('review page',page_index,'count',len(page_items))
    if not page_items:
        break
    for r in page_items:
        txt=((r.get('title') or '')+' '+(r.get('text') or ''))
        for m in re.finditer(r'\b(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(hours?|hrs?)\b', txt, flags=re.IGNORECASE):
            review_hour_values.append(float(m.group(1)))
    page_index+=1
print('verified hour values from reviews',review_hour_values)

all_vals=verified_hour_values+review_hour_values
print('all verified hour mentions',all_vals)

# mode computation
if all_vals:
    cnt=collections.Counter(all_vals)
    print('counter',cnt)
    maxfreq=max(cnt.values())
    modes=[v for v,f in cnt.items() if f==maxfreq]
    print('modes',modes)
    modes_sorted=sorted(modes)
    print('chosen',modes_sorted[0])
else:
    print('no hour mentions found')
